input: I'm flying to Lisbon on May 10. Give me the checklist of what to do until then.

checks.description: Checklist with concrete dates calculated from the departure date (any month-day date other than May 10, which is already in the question)
Points to the official ETIAS/EES site
Includes a section of items to confirm on an official site
Says to put medications and documents in carry-on baggage
